description: Check a payout beneficiary's tax ID and bank account (or PIX key) for Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia or Uruguay before sending money. Validates format, check digits and bank code against central-bank directories. Returns verdict ready | review | invalid with error codes and bank name. MX: RFC + CLABE. BR: CPF/CNPJ + PIX key. AR: CUIT/CUIL + CBU/CVU. CL/CO/UY: tax ID + account with bank_code. Does not confirm account ownership.

account.description: CLABE (MX), CBU/CVU (AR), or local account number (CL, CO, UY; needs bank_code)

bank_code.description: CL: CMF code (012 BancoEstado). CO: CENIT code (1007 Bancolombia, 1507 Nequi). UY: BCU code (001 BROU, 113 Itau)

country.description: ISO country code of the beneficiary

tax_id.description: RFC (MX), CPF/CNPJ (BR), CUIT/CUIL (AR), RUT (CL), NIT (CO), RUT/CI (UY)

name: validate_payout_beneficiary
title: Validate LATAM payout beneficiary
